items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Cyber, rated Critical for cybersecurity and available via Daybreak Red
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6 Cyber，網路安全評級Critical，透過Daybreak Red提供
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced GPT-6 Cyber on November 5 as a major advance in aligned cybersecurity agents. It scores 48.5% on ExploitGym (up from 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber), shows near-perfect scope adherence, and has already produced 948 Linux kernel exploits and 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox vulnerabilities. Access starts with select Daybreak Red customers.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月5日宣布推出GPT-6 Cyber，強調在授權範圍內尋找與驗證漏洞的能力大幅提升。模型在ExploitGym達48.5%（較GPT-5.6 Cyber的32.1%明顯進步），範圍內對齊表現接近完美，並已協助開發948個Linux核心漏洞利用與發現81個先前未知的Firefox高嚴重性漏洞。目前先開放給部分Daybreak Red客戶。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the clearest public signal yet that frontier models can move from assisted code review into autonomous exploit development and patch suggestion at scale. The Critical rating and tight Daybreak gating underscore both the defensive upside and the dual-use risk that remains under controlled access.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是目前最明確的公開訊號，顯示前沿模型已能從輔助程式碼審查推進到大規模自主漏洞利用與修補建議。Critical評級與Daybreak嚴格控管同時凸顯防禦價值與雙重用途風險，後者仍在受控存取下運作。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing GPT‑6 Cyber, a major leap in security research: more capable at finding and fixing vulnerabilities, and far more reliable staying within the boundaries researchers set.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出GPT‑6 Cyber，這是安全研究的重大躍進：更擅長發現與修復漏洞，且在研究人員設定的範圍內保持高度可靠。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches Personal Finance in Claude (US beta on Pro/Max/Ultra)
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic推出Claude Personal Finance（美國Pro/Max/Ultra測試版）
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic introduced Personal Finance in Claude on November 5. US users on Pro, Max, and Ultra plans can connect bank and card accounts via Plaid for read-only access; Claude answers questions about balances, spending categories, and transactions but cannot move or invest money. Conversations in the hub are not used for training.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月5日推出Claude的Personal Finance功能。美國Pro、Max與Ultra方案用戶可透過Plaid連接銀行與信用卡帳戶，取得唯讀存取；Claude能回答餘額、支出分類與交易問題，但無法移動或投資資金。該功能內的對話不會用於訓練模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: The read-only design and explicit non-advice stance reduce immediate regulatory exposure compared with agentic finance tools, yet connecting real bank data still expands Claude’s surface for sensitive personal information and sets up later professional integrations.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 唯讀設計與明確不提供建議的定位，相較於能直接操作資金的代理工具，降低了即時監管風險；但連接真實銀行資料仍擴大Claude處理敏感個人資訊的範圍，並為後續與專業機構合作鋪路。
items_flat.quote: Access is read-only, and Personal Finance can’t move, manage, or invest your money.
items_flat.quote_zh: 存取為唯讀，Personal Finance無法移動、管理或投資你的資金。

items_flat.title_en: Google releases Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with 15-second video and 30% lower pricing
items_flat.title_zh: Google發布Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，支援15秒影片並降價30%
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind and Google Cloud made Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available on November 5. The update raises native video length from 10 to 15 seconds, adds multi-turn conversational editing, improves reference adherence and speech, and cuts 720p pricing to $0.07 per second (30% below Omni 1.1). Outputs carry SynthID watermarks.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind與Google Cloud於11月5日讓Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash正式上線。更新將原生影片長度從10秒提升至15秒、加入多輪對話式編輯、強化參考遵循與語音品質，並將720p價格降至每秒0.07美元（較Omni 1.1低30%）。輸出帶有SynthID浮水印。
items_flat.analysis_en: Longer clips plus cheaper drafts-and-upscale workflows lower the barrier for high-volume commercial video (ads, try-ons, explainers). Consistency gains matter more for brand work than raw length, but jump-cut reduction and multi-turn editing still leave room for further refinement.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更長片段加上更便宜的草稿再升級流程，降低高量商業影片（廣告、虛擬試穿、說明片）的門檻。一致性進步對品牌工作比單純長度更重要，但跳切減少與多輪編輯仍有進一步精煉空間。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re rolling out Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, and making it generally available across the Gemini API and Gemini for business.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，並讓它在Gemini API與Gemini for business正式上線。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches Images 2.6 with GIF creation, faster generation, and two new API models
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI推出Images 2.6，支援GIF生成、更快速度與兩款新API模型
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced Images 2.6 for ChatGPT, Codex, and the API on November 4. The update generates images 50% faster than the prior version, adds native GIF creation from prompts or images (with frame editing and speed control), and introduces improved editing that better preserves details across changes.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月4日宣布Images 2.6適用於ChatGPT、Codex與API。更新使圖片生成速度較前一版本快50%，新增從提示或圖片原生生成GIF（可編輯影格與調整速度），並強化編輯時保留細節的能力。
items_flat.analysis_en: The release expands OpenAI’s image stack from static generation into lightweight animation and tighter iterative editing, which matters for consumer and developer workflows that previously required external tools.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此版本將OpenAI的圖像能力從靜態生成擴展到輕量動畫與更緊密的迭代編輯，對先前需要外部工具的消費者與開發者工作流程有實質影響。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing Images 2.6 in ChatGPT, Codex, and the API, bringing your ideas to life faster. With this, you can bring motion to your images with GIFs — from animating a brand mascot or character to turning a product shot into an eye-catching loop.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們在 ChatGPT、Codex 與 API 推出 Images 2.6，讓你的想法更快實現。透過 GIF，你可以為影像加入動態——從動畫品牌吉祥物或角色，到把產品照片變成吸睛的循環動畫。

items_flat.title_en: Riot Platforms names Anthropic as tenant of $28B Corsicana, Texas campus lease
items_flat.title_zh: Riot Platforms指名Anthropic為德州Corsicana園區280億美元租約承租方
items_flat.summary_en: In its Q3 2026 10-Q filed November 4–5, Riot Platforms identified Anthropic PBC as the counterparty to a 15-year lease covering 910 MW of critical IT capacity at its Corsicana, Texas campus, valued at roughly $28 billion in contracted revenue.
items_flat.summary_zh: Riot Platforms在11月4–5日提交的2026年第三季10-Q中，指明Anthropic PBC為其德州Corsicana園區15年租約的相對方，涵蓋910 MW關鍵IT容量，合約收入約280億美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: The disclosure confirms Anthropic as a major long-term power and capacity customer of a Bitcoin-miner-turned-data-center landlord, underscoring the scale of compute commitments from frontier labs.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此揭露確認Anthropic是比特幣礦商轉型資料中心房東的主要長期電力與容量客戶，凸顯前沿實驗室的運算承諾規模。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic adds security center, inference hooks, and admin controls to Claude Enterprise
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic為Claude Enterprise新增安全中心、推論鉤子與管理控管
items_flat.summary_en: On November 5 Anthropic published new Claude Enterprise features for security teams: a security center that compares settings to recommended configurations, generally available inference hooks that send prompts and tool calls to external data-security tools, centralized management via admin.claude.com, IP allowlisting, and Admin API sign-out.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月5日發布Claude Enterprise的新安全與管理功能：安全中心可對照建議設定、推論鉤子可將提示與工具呼叫送至外部資料安全工具、集中管理入口admin.claude.com、IP允許清單，以及透過Admin API登出成員。
items_flat.analysis_en: These controls address the operational reality of deploying coding and agentic features at enterprise scale. Inference hooks in particular give security teams a practical interception point without requiring Anthropic to rebuild every customer’s policy engine.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這些控管對應企業大規模部署程式碼與代理功能的實際需求。推論鉤子尤其讓安全團隊有實際攔截點，無需Anthropic重建每位客戶的政策引擎。
items_flat.quote: Claude Enterprise has new security and admin features, including a security center, generally available inference hooks, centralized management, and additional access controls.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude Enterprise新增安全與管理功能，包括安全中心、正式可用的推論鉤子、集中管理與額外存取控管。

items_flat.title_en: Meta rolls out real-time voice and expressive avatars in the Muse app
items_flat.title_zh: Meta在Muse應用程式推出即時語音與表情頭像
items_flat.summary_en: Meta announced on November 5 that voice conversations and expressive avatars are rolling out in the Muse app (US first, mobile/web/Mac). Users tap a phone icon to speak; Muse responds in real time, can be interrupted, continues background work, and displays matching facial expressions and gestures. Hundreds of voices are available; AI Glasses and Muse Charm support is coming soon.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta於11月5日宣布，即時語音對話與表情頭像開始在Muse應用程式推出（先從美國，涵蓋手機、網頁與Mac）。用戶點擊電話圖示即可說話；Muse即時回應、可被打斷，並在背景持續處理任務，同時以匹配的表情與手勢呈現。提供數百種語音，AI眼鏡與Muse Charm即將支援。
items_flat.analysis_en: Voice plus a reactive avatar moves Muse closer to the always-available personal agent Meta has described, especially for hands-free or walk-and-talk use. US-only rollout and the still-limited geographic footprint of Muse itself remain the practical constraints on immediate scale.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 語音加上會反應的頭像，讓Muse更接近Meta描述的隨時可用個人代理，尤其適合免手操作或邊走邊談的情境。目前僅限美國推出，加上Muse本身地理覆蓋仍有限，是立即擴大規模的實際限制。
items_flat.quote: We’re rolling out voice and expressive avatars in the Muse app, giving you a new, natural way to interact with your Muse.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們在Muse應用程式推出語音與表情頭像，讓你以更自然的方式與Muse互動。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer to deepen Codex code infrastructure
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI將收購Pierre Computer，深化Codex程式碼基礎建設
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced on November 4 that it will acquire Pierre Computer Company, the startup behind Code Storage and open-source developer tools (Trees and Diffs) already used in Codex. The deal aims to advance source control for agentic coding.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月4日宣布將收購Pierre Computer Company，該新創提供Code Storage與已用於Codex的開源開發工具（Trees與Diffs）。交易旨在推進代理式程式設計的原始碼控管。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move gives OpenAI more control over the storage and review layer that coding agents depend on, positioning Codex as a more self-contained platform rather than relying solely on external infrastructure.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉讓OpenAI更能掌控程式代理依賴的儲存與審查層，使Codex成為更自包含的平台，而非僅依賴外部基礎設施。
items_flat.quote: Today we're announcing that OpenAI will acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc. ... Once the acquisition closes, our ambition is to advance the future of source control across the industry.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布 OpenAI 將收購 Pierre Computer Company, Inc。……收購完成後，我們的目標是推動整個產業的原始碼控制未來發展。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic biology team uses Claude to map first 3D structure of a bacterial vault particle
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic生物學團隊使用Claude繪製首個細菌vault粒子3D結構
items_flat.summary_en: On November 4 Anthropic published research from its biology team showing that Claude assisted at multiple stages—sequence search, isolation optimization, and structure determination—to produce the first 3D cryo-EM structure of a vault-like particle from bacteria.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月4日發布生物學團隊研究，顯示Claude在多個階段協助（序列搜尋、分離優化與結構測定），產出首個細菌來源vault樣粒子的3D冷凍電鏡結構。
items_flat.analysis_en: The result is a concrete example of an AI model participating in a multi-step structural biology workflow rather than only literature summarization. Function of vaults remains unknown.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此結果是AI模型參與多步驟結構生物學工作流程的具體例子，而非僅做文獻摘要。vault的功能仍未知。
items_flat.quote: We’re sharing how our biology research team worked with Claude to map the first 3D structure of a vault particle from bacterial life.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們分享生物學研究團隊如何與 Claude 合作，繪製細菌生命中 vault 粒子的首個 3D 結構。

items_flat.title_en: Cat Wu, former Claude Code product lead, joins OpenAI to lead Core Products PM
items_flat.title_zh: 前Claude Code產品負責人Cat Wu加入OpenAI，領導Core Products產品管理
items_flat.summary_en: On November 5 Cat Wu announced on X that she is joining OpenAI to lead product management for Core Products, after stating that her last day at Anthropic was late October. She previously led product for Claude Code and Cowork. OpenAI confirmed the move.
items_flat.summary_zh: Cat Wu於11月5日在X宣布加入OpenAI，領導Core Products的產品管理；她表示在Anthropic的最後一天是10月底。她先前負責Claude Code與Cowork產品。OpenAI確認此人事異動。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move is a notable talent shift in the coding-agent race between Claude Code and Codex. Product leadership continuity at Anthropic on its highest-visibility developer tool is now interrupted.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此人事異動是Claude Code與Codex代理程式競賽中的明顯人才流動。Anthropic在其最高能見度開發者工具上的產品領導連續性已中斷。
items_flat.quote: Some news: I’m joining OpenAI to lead product management for Core Products! I have a lot of respect for OpenAI for showing the world that scaling works, for bringing AI to over a billion people, and for believing great products are core to the mission.
items_flat.quote_zh: 一些消息：我即將加入 OpenAI，領導核心產品的產品管理工作！我很尊敬 OpenAI 向世界證明擴大規模有效、將 AI 帶到超過十億人，並相信優秀產品是使命的核心。

anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月5日推出Claude的Personal Finance功能。美國Pro、Max與Ultra方案用戶可透過Plaid連接銀行與信用卡帳戶，取得唯讀存取；Claude能回答餘額、支出分類與交易問題，但無法移動或投資資金。該功能內的對話不會用於訓練模型。
anthropic.analysis_en: The read-only design and explicit non-advice stance reduce immediate regulatory exposure compared with agentic finance tools, yet connecting real bank data still expands Claude’s surface for sensitive personal information and sets up later professional integrations.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 唯讀設計與明確不提供建議的定位，相較於能直接操作資金的代理工具，降低了即時監管風險；但連接真實銀行資料仍擴大Claude處理敏感個人資訊的範圍，並為後續與專業機構合作鋪路。
anthropic.quote: Access is read-only, and Personal Finance can’t move, manage, or invest your money.
anthropic.quote_zh: 存取為唯讀，Personal Finance無法移動、管理或投資你的資金。

anthropic.title_en: Riot Platforms names Anthropic as tenant of $28B Corsicana, Texas campus lease
anthropic.title_zh: Riot Platforms指名Anthropic為德州Corsicana園區280億美元租約承租方
anthropic.summary_en: In its Q3 2026 10-Q filed November 4–5, Riot Platforms identified Anthropic PBC as the counterparty to a 15-year lease covering 910 MW of critical IT capacity at its Corsicana, Texas campus, valued at roughly $28 billion in contracted revenue.
anthropic.summary_zh: Riot Platforms在11月4–5日提交的2026年第三季10-Q中，指明Anthropic PBC為其德州Corsicana園區15年租約的相對方，涵蓋910 MW關鍵IT容量，合約收入約280億美元。
anthropic.analysis_en: The disclosure confirms Anthropic as a major long-term power and capacity customer of a Bitcoin-miner-turned-data-center landlord, underscoring the scale of compute commitments from frontier labs.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 此揭露確認Anthropic是比特幣礦商轉型資料中心房東的主要長期電力與容量客戶，凸顯前沿實驗室的運算承諾規模。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic adds security center, inference hooks, and admin controls to Claude Enterprise
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic為Claude Enterprise新增安全中心、推論鉤子與管理控管
anthropic.summary_en: On November 5 Anthropic published new Claude Enterprise features for security teams: a security center that compares settings to recommended configurations, generally available inference hooks that send prompts and tool calls to external data-security tools, centralized management via admin.claude.com, IP allowlisting, and Admin API sign-out.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月5日發布Claude Enterprise的新安全與管理功能：安全中心可對照建議設定、推論鉤子可將提示與工具呼叫送至外部資料安全工具、集中管理入口admin.claude.com、IP允許清單，以及透過Admin API登出成員。
anthropic.analysis_en: These controls address the operational reality of deploying coding and agentic features at enterprise scale. Inference hooks in particular give security teams a practical interception point without requiring Anthropic to rebuild every customer’s policy engine.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這些控管對應企業大規模部署程式碼與代理功能的實際需求。推論鉤子尤其讓安全團隊有實際攔截點，無需Anthropic重建每位客戶的政策引擎。
anthropic.quote: Claude Enterprise has new security and admin features, including a security center, generally available inference hooks, centralized management, and additional access controls.
anthropic.quote_zh: Claude Enterprise新增安全與管理功能，包括安全中心、正式可用的推論鉤子、集中管理與額外存取控管。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic biology team uses Claude to map first 3D structure of a bacterial vault particle
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic生物學團隊使用Claude繪製首個細菌vault粒子3D結構
anthropic.summary_en: On November 4 Anthropic published research from its biology team showing that Claude assisted at multiple stages—sequence search, isolation optimization, and structure determination—to produce the first 3D cryo-EM structure of a vault-like particle from bacteria.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic於11月4日發布生物學團隊研究，顯示Claude在多個階段協助（序列搜尋、分離優化與結構測定），產出首個細菌來源vault樣粒子的3D冷凍電鏡結構。
anthropic.analysis_en: The result is a concrete example of an AI model participating in a multi-step structural biology workflow rather than only literature summarization. Function of vaults remains unknown.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 此結果是AI模型參與多步驟結構生物學工作流程的具體例子，而非僅做文獻摘要。vault的功能仍未知。
anthropic.quote: We’re sharing how our biology research team worked with Claude to map the first 3D structure of a vault particle from bacterial life.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們分享生物學研究團隊如何與 Claude 合作，繪製細菌生命中 vault 粒子的首個 3D 結構。

google.title_en: Google releases Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with 15-second video and 30% lower pricing
google.title_zh: Google發布Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，支援15秒影片並降價30%
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind and Google Cloud made Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available on November 5. The update raises native video length from 10 to 15 seconds, adds multi-turn conversational editing, improves reference adherence and speech, and cuts 720p pricing to $0.07 per second (30% below Omni 1.1). Outputs carry SynthID watermarks.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind與Google Cloud於11月5日讓Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash正式上線。更新將原生影片長度從10秒提升至15秒、加入多輪對話式編輯、強化參考遵循與語音品質，並將720p價格降至每秒0.07美元（較Omni 1.1低30%）。輸出帶有SynthID浮水印。
google.analysis_en: Longer clips plus cheaper drafts-and-upscale workflows lower the barrier for high-volume commercial video (ads, try-ons, explainers). Consistency gains matter more for brand work than raw length, but jump-cut reduction and multi-turn editing still leave room for further refinement.
google.analysis_zh: 更長片段加上更便宜的草稿再升級流程，降低高量商業影片（廣告、虛擬試穿、說明片）的門檻。一致性進步對品牌工作比單純長度更重要，但跳切減少與多輪編輯仍有進一步精煉空間。
google.quote: Today, we’re rolling out Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, and making it generally available across the Gemini API and Gemini for business.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，並讓它在Gemini API與Gemini for business正式上線。

meta.title_en: Meta rolls out real-time voice and expressive avatars in the Muse app
meta.title_zh: Meta在Muse應用程式推出即時語音與表情頭像
meta.summary_en: Meta announced on November 5 that voice conversations and expressive avatars are rolling out in the Muse app (US first, mobile/web/Mac). Users tap a phone icon to speak; Muse responds in real time, can be interrupted, continues background work, and displays matching facial expressions and gestures. Hundreds of voices are available; AI Glasses and Muse Charm support is coming soon.
meta.summary_zh: Meta於11月5日宣布，即時語音對話與表情頭像開始在Muse應用程式推出（先從美國，涵蓋手機、網頁與Mac）。用戶點擊電話圖示即可說話；Muse即時回應、可被打斷，並在背景持續處理任務，同時以匹配的表情與手勢呈現。提供數百種語音，AI眼鏡與Muse Charm即將支援。
meta.analysis_en: Voice plus a reactive avatar moves Muse closer to the always-available personal agent Meta has described, especially for hands-free or walk-and-talk use. US-only rollout and the still-limited geographic footprint of Muse itself remain the practical constraints on immediate scale.
meta.analysis_zh: 語音加上會反應的頭像，讓Muse更接近Meta描述的隨時可用個人代理，尤其適合免手操作或邊走邊談的情境。目前僅限美國推出，加上Muse本身地理覆蓋仍有限，是立即擴大規模的實際限制。
meta.quote: We’re rolling out voice and expressive avatars in the Muse app, giving you a new, natural way to interact with your Muse.
meta.quote_zh: 我們在Muse應用程式推出語音與表情頭像，讓你以更自然的方式與Muse互動。

brief_en: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber (Critical rating, Daybreak Red) with real-world Linux/Firefox impact. Anthropic rolled out Personal Finance beta (US Pro/Max/Ultra, read-only via Plaid) plus Enterprise security controls. Google made Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash GA with 15s video and 30% lower pricing. Meta added real-time voice and expressive avatars to Muse.
brief_zh: OpenAI發布GPT-6 Cyber（Critical等級，Daybreak Red），已在Linux與Firefox找到大量漏洞。Anthropic推出Personal Finance測試版（美國Pro/Max/Ultra，透過Plaid唯讀）及企業安全控管。Google讓Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash正式上線，支援15秒影片並降價30%。Meta為Muse加入即時語音與表情頭像。
